steps.content: This is a luxury Eastside villa, but there aren't enough guards. The enemy might flee at any moment. But judging from last night...
The assassin is very familiar with the security plan and guards' protocol around here. She must have monitored these useless idiots for quite some time and know them like the back of her hand.
Then there is the possibility that the enemy has already infiltrated the villa. If that's the case...
She pulls up the villa's surveillance screen, which shows faraway villas, sentry posts, a park in the distance, and the nearby shopping street...
Some shops on that street are closed, but haven't been emptied, so it's worth a visit. There aren't a lot of patrols right now, which works in my favor.
